title: CLOUD DRIFT
oneLiner: Guide a sleepy cloud through a gentle sky, gathering stars and avoiding storm puffs.
mechanics: Move the cloud smoothly around one screen.
Collect tiny stars to score points.
Avoid dark storm puffs that drift across the sky.
The wind and storm speed gradually increase over time.

controls.a: Release a soft breeze that nudges nearby storm puffs away

lose: The cloud dissolves after touching three storm puffs.
scoring: Each collected star scores 10 points, with occasional golden stars worth 50.
